candidates.snippet: 1662: Appointed Curator of Experiments - Became Curator of Experiments for the Royal Society, a pivotal role in his scientific career. 1665: Published Micrographia - Published his seminal work 'Micrographia', featuring detailed drawings of observations made with a microscope. 1660: Formulated Hooke's Law - Described the law of elasticity, stating that the force is proportional to the extension or compression. 1666: Appointed Surveyor of the City of London - Appointed as one of the surveyors for the rebuilding of London after the Great Fire.
